department: Doctoral Programme in Physics, School of Engineering Sciences (SCI)

deadline.value: No central deadline: apply to an advertised doctoral position; KTH announces positions nine times a year (Feb-Jun, Sep-Dec), each with its own deadline
deadline.quote: In order to apply for a doctoral program, there must be an available doctoral appointment.

also.quote: Doctoral positions are announced nine times a year: in February, March, April, May, June, September, October, November and December.

app_fee.value: Not stated on the page checked

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_general.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_physics.value: Not stated on the page checked

toefl_min.value: English 6 level, the same as for KTH master's. University Admissions sets this at TOEFL iBT 90 with 20 in writing (tests up to 20 Jan 2026) or 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale with no section below 4; IELTS 6.5 with no section below 5.5
toefl_min.quote: You need English proficiency equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. The English proficiency requirement is the same as for master's studies at KTH.

also.quote: For English 6/English Level 2*: Total score of 4.5 (scale 1-6) with no section less than 4 | For English 6/English Level 2*: Score of 20 (scale 0-30) in written test, total score of 90 | For English 6/English Level 2*: an overall score of 6.5 and no section below 5.5

english_waiver.value: Indian upper-secondary English can meet the requirement: CBSE (2008 onwards) or CISCE Class XII English grades, or an English-medium upper secondary certificate. The India page offers no degree-based route, so otherwise take a test
english_waiver.quote: You can meet the requirement by passing an English test or, depending on your country of previous studies, your completed upper secondary or university studies.

also.quote: grades in the subject English language and at least three other subjects with English as the language of instruction | grades in the subject English language stated in Indian School Certificate Class XII (year 12) that are issued by the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) | grades in the subject English language stated in Senior School Certificate Examination / Marks Statement cum Certificate that are issued by Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) from 2008 and onwards | Previous university studies and English test | You can also demonstrate that you meet the English language requirement through an internationally approved English test.

supervisor.value: You apply to a specific advertised position; the final admission decision is made by the head of school in consultation with the intended supervisors
supervisor.quote: The final decision is made by the head of school in consultation with the intended supervisors.

funding.value: People admitted to advertised positions are employed by KTH on a monthly salary, currently starting at SEK 33,000 and rising to SEK 37,100 per month
funding.quote: After your admission, you will receive your employment at KTH.

also.quote: Most doctoral students at KTH are salaried employees. | They currently start at SEK 33,000 per month at the beginning of employment and can reach up to SEK 37,100.

entry_route.value: At least 240 credits including at least 60 at master's level, a master's degree, or equivalent knowledge; individual positions may add requirements
entry_route.quote: You need completed courses of at least 240 credits (of which at least 60 credits at the master's level), a master’s degree or equivalent knowledge acquired in some other way.

notes: KTH's Doctoral Program in Physics (School of Engineering Sciences) has six specialisations; the application rules are KTH-wide. A PhD is four years full-time, with up to 20% departmental duties. English rules point to University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se), which KTH links to; its India rules are written for master's admission and KTH says the doctoral requirement is the same.
